steps.u: Add a CloudWatch alarm and SNS email for when the queue depth stays above 1000 for 10 minutes. We use Terraform.

steps.a: There is already an alerts topic, so the alarm should publish to it rather than creating a second topic. A single breach would page on spikes, so I will require 10 consecutive one-minute periods above the threshold.

i.new_string:
resource "aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm" "depth" {
  metric_name = "ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible"
  threshold = 1000
  evaluation_periods = 10
  period = 60
  comparison_operator = "GreaterThanThreshold"
  alarm_actions = [var.alerts_topic_arn]
}

steps.r: Plan: 1 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.

reference.summary: Added a Terraform CloudWatch alarm that fires when queue depth stays above 1000 for ten one-minute periods and notifies the existing alerts SNS topic; validate passes and the plan adds one resource.
facts: published to the existing alerts topic
specific: evaluation periods to avoid paging on spikes

decisions.choice: require ten consecutive periods above the threshold
decisions.reason: a single breach would page on short spikes
